title: Read an Actions check
summary: GitHub Actions can run a workflow when code changes. A workflow is a configured set of jobs and steps. Its check reports whether those steps succeeded.
introduction: GitHub Actions can run a workflow when code changes. A workflow is a configured set of jobs and steps. Its check reports whether those steps succeeded. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: GitHub Actions can run a workflow when code changes. A workflow is a configured set of jobs and steps. Its check reports whether those steps succeeded.

blocks.code:
Workflow file: .github/workflows/check.yml
Job: test
Step: run the project test command
Result: passed
blocks.title: Read an Actions check

blocks.text: The green result says the configured test command passed in that run. It does not prove the workflow checked every browser or every page.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Name one visual check that unit tests may not cover.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Read logs and configuration before relying on a badge whose checks you do not know.
For more detail later, use this [GitHub further reading](https://docs.github.com/en/get-started).
